'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nicolae Borota LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nicolae Borota]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-05-Careful_Planning-remaster.webp|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Desert Domination
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
